description: This one packs a punch. Fruit Punch is made by crossing Skunk, Haze, and Northern Lights strains and is named for its swift hit of sweet, fruity, and tropical notes. One hit packs a punch of energy, sparking the mind while relaxing the body. Fruity, sweet notes of berry make Fruit Punch a super tasty treat. Fruity Sweet Tropical
